children: Perdoceo Education entered into a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of South University Savannah (South University). The deal provides $150 million in upfront cash at closing, plus $18 million in deferred payments over 24 months and up to $56 million in earn-out payments tied to 2027–2029 EBITDA, all funded with cash on hand. Closing is expected as early as April 2027, subject to regulatory and accreditor approvals and other customary conditions, with an outside date of July 9, 2027 and a potential termination fee up to $20 million.
